stdout:
Bind a live broadcast to a stream. Use this tool to bind or unbind a live stream to/from a live broadcast.

Usage:
  yutu liveBroadcast bind [flags]

Examples:
# Bind a broadcast to a stream
yutu liveBroadcast bind --ids broadcast123 --streamId stream456
# Unbind a broadcast (omit streamId)
yutu liveBroadcast bind --ids broadcast123

Flags:
  -h, --help                                   help for bind
  -i, --ids strings                            IDs of the broadcasts to bind
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   Channel ID for content owner operations
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|silent
  -p, --parts strings                          Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,contentDetails,status])
  -s, --streamId string                        ID of the live stream to bind
      --yes                                    Confirm the operation
